sentences.text: [Order of the Court was made by K.K.SASIDHARAN, J.]

The petitioner filed this Writ Petition to direct the respondents not to interfere in his business of sale of non-edible oil products under the name and style of Vetrivel Gingelly oil and Thanga Mayil Groundnut oil except under due process of law.
2.It is the grievance of the petitioner that the respondents had initiated action by seizing of the products without following due process of law.

The petitioner, therefore, filed this writ petition for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents not to seal the premises pursuant to the action taken to seize the product on allegation that he is indulged in sale of non-edible oil under the guise of edible oils.
3. The respondents are exercising power under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
There is no question of taking action against the petitioner or any other dealers without following the provisions of the Act in question.

We, therefore, dispose of the writ petition with an observation that in case action is taken by the respondents, they would follow the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, in its letter and spirit.
